name: mibi-juvenile-S01-a
refs: The adult of this species (project-owned rig render): its body plan, colours and markings. A round green-and-cream creature with a dark blue-green back, cream belly and sandy feet, two pointed leaf-green ears or flaps on its head, plantigrade legs.

prompt: Paint the JUVENILE of the creature in the references: the same species at a glance, the same colours and markings, but young. Standing on its feet, three-quarter view from the front left, facing the viewer, cute and calm. Matte painterly rendering like a children's book, light from the top left, a soft flat contact shadow under its feet.
